skills.skill: Divide a two- or three-digit number by a one-digit number, giving the quotient and remainder

misconceptions.pattern: Reports the quotient but drops the remainder (gives remainder 0 when there is a real remainder, e.g. 29 ÷ 6 answered '4 0' instead of '4 5'), or lets the remainder reach or exceed the divisor.

strategies.intent: Take out as many whole groups of the divisor as fit (that count is the quotient), then count what is left over — the remainder, which is always smaller than the divisor.
